title: Implement blocked GF(p) triangular solve (026fc832 Phase 6)
description:
Phase 6 implementation task under epic `026fc832`. Implements blocked GF(p) triangular solve building on the panelized PLE implementation. No separate design — uses standard blocked back-substitution algorithm (Higham § 14.1).

Parent epic: `026fc832`. Predecessor: panelized PLE implementation (sibling).

## Background

Closes A8 rows 47-58, 75 (solve cells over GF(7/251/65521) and GF(31)).

## Success Criteria

- [hard] Production code implementing blocked triangular solve calling into the panelized PLE + `fp_small_try_gemm_classical`.
- [hard] Bit-exact correctness vs the existing scalar solve on a proptest sweep across GF(7), GF(31), GF(127), GF(241), GF(251), GF(65521) at boundary lengths plus rank-deficient regimes.
- [hard] 5-trial CCX1-pinned benchmarks at n in {64, 256, 1024} per prime per regime.
- [hard] Every A8 solve cell (rows 47-58, 75) either PASSes or carries [aspirational] amendment.
- [hard] No regression on currently-PASSing cells (delta ≤ 5%).
- [hard] No `unsafe` outside kernel crates.
- [hard] Brief design rationale in the impl task's evidence doc explaining the blocking strategy (no separate design task because the algorithm is standard).

## Out of scope

- Sibling impls.
- New PLE algorithm work (reuse the sibling's output).
